MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink Mini cameras could complement my Blink XT2 with indoor coverage, making them a practical extension of my security setup.",
    "The Echo Show displays connect my interest in cameras with a useful screen for compatible camera feeds; I would choose the Show 8 because its larger screen better serves that purpose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dots and Echo Flex offer voice features, but I do not currently have a need for a standalone speaker; my interest is in viewing video and monitoring cameras.",
    "An HD Fire TV Stick adds little when I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television. The tablet and smart plug also lack a clear purpose in my current setup.",
    "The Blink Mini fits my interests, but a three-camera bundle may exceed my indoor coverage needs, and plug-in placement limits where I could use it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV and Blink purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa-compatible device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Owning a streaming device seems to have been treated as a reason to want another one, without considering whether it adds a capability I lack."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent camera and television purchases suggest that useful video features matter more to me right now than voice-only convenience.",
    "I care about how a device complements what I already own: a larger camera-viewing screen or useful indoor coverage has a clearer role than another streaming stick or speaker."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected-home interests but stretched them into broad Alexa interest instead of focusing on useful additions to my camera and TV setup."
}
